description: 24 tasks in 6 classes of 4 for #530 tool-calling corpus — reusable verbatim for EDASES A/B

tasks.title: Simple scalar — search users by query
tasks.description: User asks to find users matching a simple query string. Single required scalar param.
tasks.prompt: Find users matching 'alice'.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == search_users, query == 'alice', limit/cursor optional omitted, pattern/length constraints pass
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: query maxLength 200, limit default 20 hidden; minimal shows name/type/required only

tasks.title: Simple scalar — get artefact by ID
tasks.description: Retrieve artefact by stable ID — single string scalar with hidden pattern.
tasks.prompt: Get artefact art_abc-123.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == get_artefact, id pattern ^art_[a-z0-9-]+$ passes (hidden)
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: pattern ^art_[a-z0-9-]+$ not in minimal

tasks.title: Simple scalar — set severity level
tasks.description: Set severity to a single enum scalar (enum visible in minimal).
tasks.prompt: Set severity for art_abc-123 to high.
tasks.success_criteria: level enum critical/high/medium/low visible in minimal; correct selection
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: artefact_id pattern hidden

tasks.title: Simple scalar — archive artefact with reason
tasks.description: Archive with short string reason (hidden minLength 5).
tasks.prompt: Archive art_abc-123 because it was superseded by the new design.

expected_args.reason: superseded by new design for clarity

tasks.success_criteria: reason length 5-500 passes; hidden minLength not shown in minimal
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: reason minLength 5, maxLength 500

tasks.title: Enum required — create artefact type
tasks.description: Creation requires enum type; literal must be visible in minimal.
tasks.prompt: Create a spec artefact titled 'My Spec'.
tasks.success_criteria: type enum [spec/decision/evidence/review] visible; correct enum chosen
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: title maxLength 200 hidden

tasks.title: Enum optional — create review with severity
tasks.description: Optional enum severity; task requires choosing correct enum when supplied.
tasks.prompt: Create a review for art_abc-123 verdict approve, rationale 'This rationale has enough length to pass hidden minLength ten', severity high.

expected_args.rationale: This rationale has enough length to pass hidden minLength ten

tasks.success_criteria: verdict enum [approve/request_changes/reject], severity enum [critical/high/medium/low] visible; optional enum supplied correctly
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: rationale minLength 10 hidden

tasks.title: Enum multiple — link artefacts relation
tasks.description: Task requires choosing relation enum among multiple valid values.
tasks.prompt: Link art_abc-123 to art_def-456 with relation depends_on.
tasks.success_criteria: relation enum [depends_on/supersedes/relates_to] visible; correct chosen
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: source_id pattern hidden

tasks.title: Enum semantically similar — set artefact state vs update status
tasks.description: Two ops with similar state enums must be disambiguated; enum literals visible per op.
tasks.prompt: Set artefact art_abc-123 state to active (lifecycle state, not review status).
tasks.success_criteria: state enum [draft/active/archived] visible and distinct from status enum [draft/active/archived] naming but op_id differs; model must select set_artefact_state not update_artefact_status
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: artefact_id pattern hidden; state enum visible

tasks.title: Nested object — query_metrics filter
tasks.description: Filter is a nested object with type field.
tasks.prompt: Query metrics for type spec.
tasks.success_criteria: filter object with nested enum type=spec; output facets not required
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: filter.type enum hidden nested? actually nested enum visible via minimal nested_enums; filter.since date-time format hidden
tasks.variant_sensitivity: high — nested object semantics weak in minimal

tasks.title: Array of objects — submit_evidence
tasks.description: evidence_items is array<object> with required source/content.
tasks.prompt: Attach evidence to art_abc-123: source paper, content 'evidence text from experiment'.
tasks.success_criteria: array minItems 1, nested content 1-2000, correct structure
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: content minLength hidden, weight maximum 1 hidden

tasks.title: Nested optional — query_metrics with optional group_by and facets
tasks.description: Optional nested grouping and faceting params.
tasks.prompt: Query metrics for review artefacts since 2026-01-01, group by status and include facets.
tasks.success_criteria: filter.since date-time format passes (hidden), group_by enum, include_facets boolean
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: since format date-time hidden; mutually constrained filter.type ↔ group_by hidden

tasks.title: Nested enum — query_metrics filter with enum and group_by
tasks.description: Enum lives inside nested object; minimal must preserve nested enum literals.
tasks.prompt: Query metrics filter type decision, group by severity.
tasks.success_criteria: nested enum visible in minimal via nested_enums; correct selection
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: filter.type enum [spec/decision/evidence/review] hidden nested but preserved via nested_enums in minimal

tasks.title: R/O ambiguity — omit optional cursor
tasks.description: Search without optional pagination cursor.
tasks.prompt: Search artefacts for 'auth' (first page, no cursor).
tasks.success_criteria: cursor omitted correctly; required query present; no extraneous optional
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: cursor pattern hidden, should not be invented when omitted

tasks.title: R/O ambiguity — supply optional cursor
tasks.description: Search with optional cursor supplied.
tasks.prompt: Search artefacts for 'spec' page two, cursor cur_abc123, limit 5.
tasks.success_criteria: cursor pattern ^cur_[a-z0-9]+$ passes (hidden), limit within 1-100 (hidden)
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: cursor pattern, limit range hidden

tasks.title: R/O ambiguity — create artefact with optional body and tags
tasks.description: Both body and tags optional; task supplies both.
tasks.prompt: Create a decision artefact titled 'Trade-off', body 'We chose X over Y because...', tags ['arch','adr-12'].

expected_args.title: Trade-off
expected_args.body: We chose X over Y because...

tasks.success_criteria: optional body/tags correctly supplied; tags array ≤10 hidden
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: tags maxItems 10 hidden, body maxLength 5000 hidden

tasks.title: R/O ambiguity — semantically similar optional fields
tasks.description: Optional fields with similar meanings (comment vs note vs reason) must not be confused.
tasks.prompt: Set artefact state for art_abc-123 to archived with comment 'superseded'.
tasks.success_criteria: comment supplied to set_artefact_state, not reason (archive_artefact) or note (submit_evidence); optional disambiguation
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: comment maxLength 500 hidden

tasks.title: Similar tools — search_users
tasks.description: Among three near-identical search_* ops, pick users.
tasks.prompt: Find the user named Alice in engineering.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == search_users (not search_groups/search_projects); description differs by one word (users/groups/projects) and stable ID must be used
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: department enum visible, limit range hidden

tasks.title: Similar tools — search_groups
tasks.description: Pick groups among similar tools.
tasks.prompt: Search for the engineering group called platform.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == search_groups; visibility optional not confused
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: visibility enum visible

tasks.title: Similar tools — search_projects
tasks.description: Pick projects among similar tools.
tasks.prompt: Search projects for Atlas with status active.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == search_projects; status enum [active/archived/planning] visible
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: status enum visible, limit hidden

tasks.title: Similar tools — disambiguate with overlapping terms
tasks.description: Query contains team/group/project words; model must use stable ID not description keyword matching.
tasks.prompt: Search for project team 'atlas-platform' — this is a project, not a user or group.
tasks.success_criteria: op_id == search_projects despite query containing 'team' and 'platform' that also match user/group vocab; stable ID is discriminating signal
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: query maxLength 200 hidden; description tokens do not leak

tasks.title: Hidden constraint — numeric range limit 1-100
tasks.description: Limit range is hidden from minimal; valid call within range should pass, values outside would be rejected.
tasks.prompt: Search artefacts for 'test' with limit 20.
tasks.success_criteria: limit=20 within 1-100 passes; minimal does not show min/max but runtime enforces; selection must not invent out-of-range value
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: limit minimum 1 maximum 100 — causes ValidationFailed if violated, not exposed to model

tasks.title: Hidden constraint — string pattern ^art_[a-z0-9-]+$
tasks.description: ID pattern is hidden; valid ID must be constructed correctly without seeing pattern.
tasks.prompt: Get artefact art_valid-001.
tasks.success_criteria: id matches ^art_[a-z0-9-]+$ (hidden); minimal shows type string required only
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: pattern ^art_[a-z0-9-]+$ hidden; also cursor ^cur_[a-z0-9]+$, version semver hidden

tasks.title: Hidden constraint — mutually constrained filter.type ↔ group_by
tasks.description: When filter.type is supplied, group_by must not equal filter.type (hidden mutual constraint).
tasks.prompt: Query metrics for type spec, group by status.
tasks.success_criteria: valid combination passes; invalid would be group_by='spec' when filter.type='spec' -> hidden ValidationFailed; minimal shows names/types/enum but not constraint sentence
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: mutually constrained: filter.type != group_by (runtime check beyond JSON Schema if/then, enforced as ValidationFailed)

tasks.title: Hidden constraint — additionalProperties:false and maxLength cause ValidationFailed
tasks.description: Schema constraint hidden; task must not add extra field, and must respect maxLength.
tasks.prompt: Create a spec artefact with title 'Short title' (no extra fields).
tasks.success_criteria: no unknown field (additionalProperties:false hidden), title within 1-200 hidden; valid call executes; malformed extra or long title would be ValidationFailed hidden
tasks.hidden_constraint_exercised: additionalProperties:false, maxLength 200 hidden; violation surfaces as ValidationFailed ValidationFailed not exposed to model
